content.title: TruGolf Links signs franchise development deal in Tennessee
content.summary: TruGolf (TRUG) Links Franchising announced the signing of another regional development deal with Knoxville, Tennessee native, John Young. As the Regional Developer for TruGolf Links, he is leading a statewide expansion of the indoor golf concept, starting with the first flagship location in Knoxville. With plans to develop 40 locations across Tennessee, John is focused on creating a modern, accessible, inclusive, and community-driven golf experience for players of all skill levels. Published fir
